response.paragraph: You stayed grounded in integrity, attention to detail, and empathy as you worked through fit-up problems, an apprentice’s weld, and a failed ventilation fan. Deciding whether to weld or replace a part—and responding when an inspector rejected your weld—gave you practice balancing quality, safety, and teamwork. These are practice signals, not a verdict, and they point to strengths worth exploring across nursing, welding, and electrical work.
